# salaryfact.com
> Free salary percentile calculator. See where your pay ranks nationally, in your state and in your field, using Bureau of Labor Statistics wage data.

## What this tool does
- Calculates your salary percentile nationally, by state and by job field
- Compares your pay to US workers using Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2025 release
- Covers all 50 states plus DC and 15 job fields: technology, healthcare, finance, education, legal, engineering, sales, management, creative, trades, hospitality, retail, transportation, government and other
- Reads percentiles from the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th points that BLS publishes, with interpolation between them. BLS does not publish a wage above the 90th percentile in this dataset, so the calculator does not rank above it

## Data source
BLS OEWS, May 2025 release, "All Occupations" cross-industry figures (national and state files). Job field medians come from the matching Standard Occupational Classification major groups.

## Key facts (BLS OEWS, May 2025)
- National median annual wage: $50,980
- National percentiles: 10th $31,200; 25th $37,590; 75th $80,520; 90th $128,560
- Highest state median: District of Columbia, $91,540. Lowest: Mississippi, $40,120
- California's median is $58,240 and New York's is $59,670, about 14% and 17% above the national median
- Highest field medians: Management & Executive $126,520, Technology & Software $109,280, Engineering $108,620, Legal & Compliance $102,500
- Lowest field medians: Retail & Customer Service $34,810 and Hospitality & Food Service $35,050

## Page types
- State pages: https://salaryfact.com/state/{state-code} (51 pages; example /state/ca)
- City pages: https://salaryfact.com/city/{city-slug} (181 pages; example /city/houston)
- Job field pages: https://salaryfact.com/category/{field} (15 pages; example /category/technology)
- Methodology: https://salaryfact.com/methodology

## Not supported
The calculator does not accept URL parameters. Link to the state, city or field page you mean.

## Tool URL
https://salaryfact.com
